const topic = $input.first().json.Topic || '';
const tone = $input.first().json.Tone || 'professional';

const prompt = `You are a LinkedIn content expert. Write a LinkedIn post strictly following this format.

Topic: ${topic}
Tone: ${tone}

---FORMAT TO FOLLOW EXACTLY---

Line 1: [relevant emoji] [Topic Title]: [Catchy subtitle]

[blank line]

One sentence explanation of what the topic is.

[blank line]

👉 Real-time Example: [Relatable real-world scenario]
[emoji] [sub-point 1]
[emoji] [sub-point 2]
[emoji] [sub-point 3]
[emoji] [sub-point 4]
All are part of one closing sentence.

[blank line]

⚡ Pros:
[positive point] [emoji]
[positive point] [emoji]

[blank line]

⚠️ Cons:
[negative point]
[negative point] [emoji]

[blank line]

💡 In short: [One sentence summary with core tradeoff]

[blank line]

💬 Question for you: [Engaging question to spark comments]

👇 Share your thoughts!

#Hashtag1 #Hashtag2 #Hashtag3 #Hashtag4 #Hashtag5
---END FORMAT---

Return ONLY the post text.`;

return [{ json: { prompt: prompt } }];
